passage.label: Revelation from the Mighty Wise; Book sent in truth with the command to worship Allah sincere in religion; pure religion belongs to Him while those taking protectors claim nearness; judgement over their dispute and no guidance for the lying disbeliever; son-taking refuted by free choice among creation, He is One Prevailing; heavens and earth created in truth, night wrapped over day, sun and moon running to a term; creation from one soul with its mate, eight mates of livestock, creation after creation in three darknesses; disbelief not approved though He is free of need, gratitude approved, no bearer carries another's burden; adversity-call then favour-forgetting and setting up equals; the night-devout prostrating and standing contrasted with the heedless, knowers unequal to non-knowers; fear of the Lord, spacious earth, patient reward without account

arabicExcerpts.text: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَٱعۡبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ

أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلۡخَالِصُۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ مَا نَعۡبُدُهُمۡ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلۡفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ فِي مَا هُمۡ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَنۡ هُوَ كَٰذِبٞ كَفَّارٞ
لَّوۡ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدٗا لَّٱصۡطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ

خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيۡلِۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ يَجۡرِي لِأَجَلٖ مُّسَمًّىۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفَّـٰرُ

خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفۡسٖ وَٰحِدَةٖ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۡهَا زَوۡجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزۡوَٰجٖۚ يَخۡلُقُكُمۡ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡ خَلۡقٗا مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ خَلۡقٖ فِي ظُلُمَٰتٖ ثَلَٰثٖۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصۡرَفُونَ

إِن تَكۡفُرُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنكُمۡۖ وَلَا يَرۡضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلۡكُفۡرَۖ وَإِن تَشۡكُرُواْ يَرۡضَهُ لَكُمۡۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

۞وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ ضُرّٞ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعۡمَةٗ مِّنۡهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدۡعُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ مِن قَبۡلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادٗا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۚ قُلۡ تَمَتَّعۡ بِكُفۡرِكَ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ

أَمَّنۡ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيۡلِ سَاجِدٗا وَقَآئِمٗا يَحۡذَرُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَيَرۡجُواْ رَحۡمَةَ رَبِّهِۦۗ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ

قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمۡۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٞۗ وَأَرۡضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّـٰبِرُونَ أَجۡرَهُم بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ

mainSubject.label: The Quran's origin in the Mighty and Wise grounding the command of sincere worship; intermediaries justified as bringers of nearness exposed as a dispute Allah will judge; divine sonship refuted through His freedom to choose, affirming Oneness and Prevailing power; truthful creation with the wrapping of night and day and the termed courses of sun and moon; human origin from one soul with its mate, paired livestock, and staged gestation within three darknesses; divine independence from human belief coupled with disapproval of disbelief and approval of gratitude; individual burden-bearing and return; the adversity-to-prosperity reversal producing forgotten calls and invented equals; nocturnal devotion contrasted with heedlessness and knowledge with ignorance; taqwa, the spaciousness of the earth, and unaccounted reward for the patient

subordinateSubjects.label: The Quran's revelation traced to Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise
The Book sent down in truth with the command to worship Allah sincerely in religion
Pure religion assigned to Allah while intermediary-worshippers plead nearness, their dispute reserved for His judgement and the lying disbeliever left unguided
Son-taking refuted by His freedom to choose from creation, with the affirmation that He is Allah, One and Prevailing
Truthful creation of heavens and earth, the mutual wrapping of night and day, and sun and moon running to a specified term
Creation from one soul with its mate, eight mates of livestock, and staged creation in the wombs within three darknesses, ending with the challenge of being averted
Divine independence of human belief, disapproval of disbelief and approval of gratitude, individual burden-bearing, and return with disclosure of deeds
Adversity prompting a solitary call, then favour causing forgetfulness and the setting up of equals to mislead, answered by brief enjoyment and the Fire
The night-devout prostrating and standing in fear and hope contrasted with the heedless, and knowers declared unequal to non-knowers
Servants commanded to fear their Lord, promised good for good deeds, reminded of the earth's spaciousness and unaccounted reward for the patient

notes: Wave 6 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the patient-reward address (10) before the commissioned say-block opens (11); P2 ends at the expanded-breast/hardened-heart contrast (22); P3 runs from the best-statement description through the mutual-working challenge (23-40); P4 covers the Book-for-people declaration through the provision signs (41-52); P5 begins with the no-despair address and runs through judgement and the grouped drivings to the Throne close (53-75).
